# Digibastion

> Free, open-source Web3 security platform with real-time threat intelligence, OpSec assessments, security checklists, and crypto wallet protection. Backed by an Ethereum Foundation ESP 2025 grant.

Digibastion helps crypto users, developers, and DAOs defend against phishing, wallet drains, smart-contract exploits, supply-chain attacks, and social engineering. The platform is 100% free, open source, and requires no account.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and security presets for new visitors.
- [About](/about): Mission, team, funding (Ethereum Foundation ESP 2025), and methodology.
- [Threat Intelligence Feed](/threat-intel): Real-time Web3 and Web2 incident feed (July 2024 onward) with severity, category, and source attribution.
- [News](/news): Curated security news and analysis.
- [Articles](/articles): 50+ in-depth guides on wallet security, phishing prevention, DeFi risks, smart-contract auditing, and OpSec.
- [Tools](/tools): Directory of vetted Web3 security tools (wallets, scanners, monitors, audit firms).
- [Links](/links): Curated security resources across application, cloud, on-chain, smart-contract, and private-key categories.
- [OpSec Quiz](/quiz): Interactive Satoshi-level OpSec assessment with HMAC-signed scoring.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top 100 quiz scores from the community.
- [Services](/services): Paid engagements — OpSec consulting and full-stack security reviews.
- [OpSec Consulting](/services/opsec-consulting): 1:1 OpSec hardening for individuals, founders, and treasuries.
- [Full-Stack Security Review](/services/full-stack-review): Smart contracts, APIs, frontend, cloud, identity, and compliance review.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team for support, partnerships, or research collaboration.
- [Support](/support): Help center and donation options.
- [Share](/share): Tools to share the platform with your community.

## Security Categories

- [OpSec](/category/opsec): 34-item Satoshi-level operational security checklist.
- [Wallet Security](/category/wallet): Hardware wallets, seed phrase protection, hot vs cold storage.
- [DeFi Security](/category/defi): Protocol risks, flash loans, oracle manipulation, bridge security.
- [Developers](/category/developers): Secure Solidity practices, audit prep, fuzzing, formal verification.
- [Authentication](/category/authentication): 2FA, SIM-swap prevention, password managers.
- [Browsing](/category/browsing): Safe browsing, extension hygiene, phishing defense.
- [Email](/category/email): Email security and anti-phishing practices.
- [Social](/category/social): Social engineering defense across Discord, Telegram, X.
- [OS](/category/os): Operating system hardening for crypto users.
- [Mobile](/category/mobile): Mobile device security for wallet apps.
- [Jobs](/category/jobs): Crypto job-scam recognition and developer interview safety.
